mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 1.5% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 5% signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction sector earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% combined with a federal funds rate below 2% signals inflationary pressure with accommodative policy, which compresses real discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% over 2 months AND FEDFUNDS < 2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
